requirement: gift cert status should update itself based on remaining value — if it hits zero its fully redeemed, if its less than original its partially redeemed
hidden_intent: Before-save flow on Gift Certificate: Remaining = 0 -> Fully Redeemed; 0 < Remaining < Original -> Partially Redeemed; never override Cancelled/Expired/Draft.

expect.notes: Uses Remaining_Value__c vs Original_Value__c; must not overwrite terminal statuses; check AgentGiftCertificateActions/IssueGiftCardAction Apex for existing status logic to avoid duplicating it.
